comment: One list of packages for macOS (brew), Linux (apt-get) and Windows (winget). A null manager has a note. 'cask:' means a Homebrew cask. install.py reads this file; scripts/check-package-names.sh checks the names.

essentials.title: Git, GitHub CLI, uv, starship prompt, jq

packages.name: uv
packages.note: apt: not in the Debian or Ubuntu archive; use brew or https://docs.astral.sh/uv/

packages.name: starship
packages.note: apt: only in new Ubuntu releases; use brew or https://starship.rs

packages.name: jq
packages.desc: JSON on the command line (the status line needs it)

core-cli.title: More Git tools and a Node version manager

packages.name: glab
packages.desc: GitLab command line (gitlab.com or a company server)
packages.note: apt: not in the archive of older releases; use brew or the GitLab release page

packages.name: fnm
packages.note: apt: not in the archive; use brew or winget

packages.name: lazygit
packages.note: apt: only in new Ubuntu releases; use brew or winget

shell.title: Shell quality of life: search, listing, history

packages.name: zsh-autosuggestions
packages.note: winget: a zsh plugin; Windows uses PSReadLine instead

packages.name: zsh-syntax-highlighting
packages.desc: colours the command line while you type
packages.note: winget: a zsh plugin; Windows uses PSReadLine instead

packages.name: zsh-history-substring-search
packages.desc: Up and Down search history for what you typed
packages.note: winget: a zsh plugin; Windows uses PSReadLine instead

packages.name: zoxide
packages.desc: jump to a folder with z

packages.name: eza
packages.desc: ls with colours and git status
packages.note: apt: only in new Ubuntu and Debian releases; the install reports it if missing

packages.name: bat
packages.note: apt: the program is called batcat; the shell config handles that

packages.name: fd
packages.note: apt: the program is called fdfind; the shell config handles that

dev-checks.title: Archive, secret scan and shell lint tools

packages.name: gitleaks
packages.note: apt: not in the archive of older releases; use brew, winget or the GitHub release

packages.name: openssl@3
packages.desc: needed to build some Python packages from source on macOS
packages.note: only for macOS source builds; Linux uses libssl-dev and Windows has wheels

data-utils.title: YAML, PDF, image and Office tools

packages.name: yq
packages.note: apt: the yq package is a different tool; use brew or winget

packages.name: ccusage
packages.note: run it with npx ccusage where no package exists

packages.name: poppler
packages.desc: pdftoppm and pdftocairo: PDF pages to images

packages.name: powershell
packages.note: apt: needs the Microsoft repository; see learn.microsoft.com/powershell

packages.name: jetbrains-mono-nerd-font
packages.desc: JetBrains Mono with the prompt icons
packages.note: apt: download the font from nerdfonts.com and copy it to ~/.local/share/fonts

packages.name: tree
packages.note: winget: Windows has a built-in tree command

packages.name: htop
packages.note: winget: no equivalent; use Task Manager

packages.name: duckdb
packages.note: apt: not in the archive; use brew, winget or the DuckDB release

packages.name: hf
packages.note: apt and winget: install with uv tool install huggingface_hub

packages.name: iterm2
packages.note: macOS only; Windows has Windows Terminal, Linux has its own terminal

packages.name: visual-studio-code
packages.note: apt: needs the Microsoft repository; see code.visualstudio.com

packages.name: sublime-text
packages.note: apt: needs the Sublime repository; see sublimetext.com

packages.name: orbstack
packages.note: macOS only; use Docker Desktop or Podman elsewhere

packages.name: temurin
packages.note: apt: add the Adoptium repository; see adoptium.net

packages.name: ollama
packages.desc: run language models on this computer
packages.note: apt: use the install script from ollama.com

packages.name: drawio
packages.desc: draw.io desktop; its CLI exports diagrams to SVG and PNG
packages.note: apt: download the .deb from the draw.io desktop release page

minimal.description: Git, GitHub CLI, uv, starship, jq

developer.description: Minimal plus shell tools, Git helpers, data utilities and a font

full.description: Developer plus everyday tools and desktop apps

work.description: Developer plus tools for a work laptop
